data.sql: WITH faults AS ( SELECT date(ts) AS fault_date, CASE WHEN hour(ts) >= 6 AND hour(ts) < 14 THEN 'A' WHEN hour(ts) >= 14 AND hour(ts) < 22 THEN 'B' ELSE 'N' END AS shift_code FROM sf_fleet.agv_telemetry WHERE agv_id = 'AGV-3' AND fault_code IS NOT NULL ) SELECT fault_date, shift_code, COUNT(*) AS fault_count FROM faults GROUP BY fault_date, shift_code ORDER BY fault_count DESC, fault_date DESC LIMIT 20
